verdict.rationale: iTerm2's first-party docs describe native tmux control-mode integration. Running 'tmux -CC' opens tmux sessions as native iTerm2 windows, and 'tmux -CC attach' restores them after an ssh drop. The docs also cover native pane splitting mapped to split-window and shared sessions for collaboration. missing for 10: independent or hands-on community corroboration of the tmux integration in practice.
